title: PortInUseException: Port 8080 is already in use when starting the embedded web server
errorSample:
Caused by: java.net.BindException: Address already in use
	at java.base/sun.nio.ch.Net.bind0(Native Method) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/sun.nio.ch.Net.bind(Net.java:577) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/sun.nio.ch.ServerSocketChannelImpl.netBind(ServerSocketChannelImpl.java:344) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/sun.nio.ch.ServerSocketChannelImpl.bind(ServerSocketChannelImpl.java:301) ~[na:na]
	at org.apache.tomcat.util.net.NioEndpoint.initServerSocket(NioEndpoint.java:339) ~[tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar:11.0.24]
	at org.apache.tomcat.util.net.NioEndpoint.bind(NioEndpoint.java:289) ~[tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar:11.0.24]
	at org.apache.tomcat.util.net.AbstractEndpoint.bindWithCleanup(AbstractEndpoint.java:2188) ~[tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar:11.0.24]
	at org.apache.tomcat.util.net.AbstractEndpoint.start(AbstractEndpoint.java:2281) ~[tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar:11.0.24]
	at org.apache.coyote.AbstractProtocol.start(AbstractProtocol.java:974) ~[tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar:11.0.24]
symptom: The web application or a @SpringBootTest with a fixed port fails to start: "Web server failed to start. Port 8080 was already in use." The root cause is java.net.BindException: Address already in use.
cause: server.port is fixed to 8080 in application.properties and another process on the machine is already listening on that port, so Tomcat cannot bind its connector.
fixSummary: Pick a different free port, for example server.port=18080 in application.properties, or server.port=0 to let the OS assign one. The port can also be overridden with the SERVER_PORT environment variable or the --server.port argument. Do not try to free port 8080 by stopping the other service.
